title: GOOD: Bearer/Basic fallthrough has no silent downgrade path
description: mail/server.rs basic_auth_middleware correctly distinguishes three cases: (1) syntactically valid base64url Bearer that fails token verification → hard 401, no fallthrough; (2) malformed base64url Bearer → falls through to Basic; (3) no Bearer prefix → Basic directly. The engineering rationale is correct: a client that intentionally sends Bearer (valid syntax) must not silently downgrade to password auth if the token is revoked. Only ambiguous (unparseable) values are treated as possible client errors and fall through. Tests well_formed_invalid_bearer_with_valid_basic_returns_401 and malformed_bearer_with_valid_basic_falls_through_to_200 verify both branches independently.
